hotels.name: Residence Inn by Marriott London Kensington
hotels.coordinate_evidence: Exact hotel/address OpenStreetMap result, 181–183 Warwick Road, W14 8PU.
hotels.format: Studios and one-/two-bedroom suites with kitchens
hotels.choice: Kitchen facilities and a named suite layout
hotels.fit: Longer stays when the exact kitchen-and-bed layout works
hotels.facts: Marriott describes kitchens and one- and two-bedroom suites. Published room descriptions include a double-bed studio and selected double- or twin-bed suites with a sofa bed. hotels.occupancy_status: Do not use the generic booking form maximum of eight as property-specific room capacity. Actual offer occupancy to confirm.
